activation_conditions: 1. Owner approval of levels, weights and a budget (budget_usd is null). Nothing is live until then, and no order is ever placed by the committee.

2. TB2: owner confirms or rejects the 2026-11-12 ruling; if confirmed, the un-pause test (no credible Nvidia-knew report from the 12-01 to 12-03 sessions or their replacements, no charge or admission naming Nvidia, permanent CEO named or credible timeline) must be met and approved by the owner.

3. TB3: owner rules the remote-access rule immaterial on evidence (licence grants for the large SG/MY operators or a company quantification of at-risk revenue) before ~2027-02-17, or rules TB3 not fired; never on price.

4. TB1 and TB4 not fired; proposed TB5 not fired if the owner adopts it. Any thesis break firing later pauses every tranche, and resting dip orders are withdrawn until the owner lifts the pause and G is recomputed.

5. Accounting gate: the Q3 10-Q is located and read (legal proceedings, any SEC disclosure, guarantee footnote); Nvidia has described the scope of the SEC matter or the 10-Q is silent on it with clean statements; no restatement, non-reliance, material weakness, auditor change or missed filing.
6. Data gate: sec_filings, the three technicals pages and tv_relative re-read in full; no activation on stale pages.
7. Gate-opening and re-anchor: nothing is eligible before G; zones recomputed on G per reanchor_rule; no chasing, no instant fills.

8. Pacing: no more than one third of total weight (2.5 of 7.5) committed before FOMC/CPI 2026-12-09/10. Only D1 (1.0) and C1 (1.0) may be eligible before the CPI 2026-12-10 session (2.0 of 7.5); D2, D3 and C2 only after it.
9. Earnings blackout: nothing new in the 3 trading days before the late-Feb 2027 print (date not confirmed); resting dip orders are withdrawn for those days and re-anchored after the print.
10. Invalidation (fundamentals): pause or drop every tranche (D1-D3, C1, C2) if guarantees_paid rises above $0, Q4 revenue lands below $126.1B, or the next-FY growth forecast falls well below 75%.
11. D1 relative gate: NVDA/SOX no new low below 14.93 for two consecutive weekly closes.

12. Every order is tagged type 'dip' (resting limit below price) or 'confirmation' (buy-stop-limit after a qualifying close); levels written down before the session they apply to, never changed intraday.

reanchor_rule: G = the date the owner records that activation conditions 1-6 all hold (not before the Q3 10-Q is read, deadline about 2026-12-04, and the 2026-12-01 to 12-03 testimony window has passed). Nothing is eligible before G. On G, after the close: (1) read 200W SMA (last completed weekly bar) and daily ATR(14); recompute D1 center = 200W(G) - ATR(G), zone = center +/- 2.0. D2, D3 (swing anchors) and C1/C2 trigger levels do not move, except C2 also needs the close above that week's 100W SMA. (2) Spacing check: if D1 mid is less than 1 ATR(G) above D2 mid, D1 is not placed this cycle and its weight is held unused (not moved to other levels). (3) Price inside or near a dip zone at G: a dip level is eligible only if its zone_high is at least 1 ATR(G) below the close on G. Otherwise it is DEFERRED and re-arms only after a daily close at least 1 ATR(G) above its zone_high; zones are never raised to meet price. (4) Price below a dip zone at G: that level is recorded 'passed before gates' (not a fill), is not bought at market, and its weight is held unused until the next owner review; the next lower level must itself pass test (3). (5) Price above a confirmation trigger at G: the tranche needs a fresh qualifying close made after G (C1: close at or below 145.71 then a close above it; C2: weekly close below 186 then a weekly close above it). (6) All levels are written down before the session they apply to and never changed intraday. (7) Re-run the same recompute after any thesis-break re-pause is lifted and after the late-Feb 2027 print (post-blackout), and record every recomputed zone in the Ladder Audit next to the zone shown here.
